item.title: 👊 Firsthand details of the assault Servicemen of the 344th Motorised Rifle Regiment (Sever Group of Forces)
item.description: Firsthand details of the assault 👊 Servicemen of the 344th Motorised Rifle Regiment (Sever Group of Forces) are breaking resistance of Ukrainian nationalists in Kharkov region. 💬 The battalion commander with the call sign 'Spartak' told about the liberation of Lukashovo and Reznikovo : 'These two settlements are next to each other, connected by a road. Small assault groups moved along treelines, through treelines, and wiped out the fortifications there. Lukashovo became our bridgehead for advance on Reznikovo.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

❗️
Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
carried out a massive strike by ground-launched high-precision weapons and long-range drones against communication and energy infrastructure facilities
in Kiev, Kiev and Kharkov regions, which are used in the interests of the defence industry of Ukraine and the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
💥
The following targets
were engaged:
📍
in Kiev:
▪️
a data processing centre (JSC Ukrsibbank),
which provided internet traffic for intelligence gathering on the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation;
▪️
the Darnitskay Power Station (TPP-4)
, which provides electric power to the defence industry in Kiev;
▪️
the Kievskaya power station (TPP-5)
supplying military facilities and enterprises of the defence industry in Kiev and Kiev region;
📍
in Kiev region:
▪️
the Kievskaya power station (TPP-6)
providing energy for military logistics facilities, weapons, and military hardware storage areas in the north-eastern part of Kiev region;
▪️
the Tripolskaya power station
providing electricity to defence industry facilities in Kiev and Kiev region;
▪️
the Kievskaya electric substation
, which ensures the transfer of electricity from the western regions of Ukraine and its distribution to the facilities of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in Kiev region;
📍
in Kharkov and Kharkov region:
▪️
the Kharkovskaya power station
providing electric power to the defence industry in Kharkov and the western part of Kharkov region;
▪️
the Zmievskaya power station
supplying electricity to AFU facilities in the south-eastern part of Kharkov region.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 Partnership forged by time Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika
item.description: Partnership forged by time 🤝 Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika took part in a solemn reception on the occasion of the 78th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. 👉 Deputy Head of the Russian military department emphasised that today Russian-Korean ties are going through one of the best periods in their entire history. The strategic partnership is based on the coincidence of fundamental national interests, common views on the international situation and world order, a high level of mutual trust, and the preservation of long-term good-neighbourliness for the benefit of the peoples of the two countries. 💬 Colonel General Vitaly Shulika, on behalf of the Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation, expressed gratitude to the leadership of the DPRK and personally to the Chairman of State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Comrade Kim Jong Un , noting the special role of Korean servicemen in the liberation of the Kursk region from the Kiev regime's armed formations, in demining and restoring Russian infrastructure facilities. ‘I am convinced that the Russian-Korean partnership's strengthening meets the fundamental interests of our countries. It makes an invaluable contribution to ensuring stability not only in the region, but throughout the world,’ Colonel General Vitaly Shulika concluded. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30024

Partnership forged by time
🤝
Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika
took part in a solemn reception on the occasion of the 78th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
👉
Deputy Head of the Russian military department emphasised that today Russian-Korean ties are going through one of the best periods in their entire history.
The strategic partnership is based on the coincidence of fundamental national interests, common views on the international situation and world order, a high level of mutual trust, and the preservation of long-term good-neighbourliness for the benefit of the peoples of the two countries.
💬
Colonel General Vitaly Shulika, on behalf of the Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation,
expressed gratitude to the leadership of the DPRK and personally to the Chairman of State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Comrade Kim Jong Un
, noting the special role of Korean servicemen in the liberation of the Kursk region from the Kiev regime's armed formations, in demining and restoring Russian infrastructure facilities.
‘I am convinced that the Russian-Korean partnership's strengthening meets the fundamental interests of our countries. It makes an invaluable contribution to ensuring stability not only in the region, but throughout the world,’ Colonel General Vitaly Shulika concluded.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 Enhancing interaction Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Vasily Osmakov and Deputy Minister of National Defence of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam Senior Lieu
item.description: Enhancing interaction 🤝 🇷🇺 🇻🇳 Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Vasily Osmakov and Deputy Minister of National Defence of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam Senior Lieutenant General Nguyen Truong Thang held the next round of the Russian-Vietnamese strategic defence dialogue. ↗️ The parties discussed the results of the first year of implementation of the five-year Plan of Military Cooperation. Certain steps were outlined to further expand bilateral interaction in the defence sphere. ✅ The commitment to make the most effective use of the accumulated potential to strengthen military cooperation in the spirit of a comprehensive strategic partnership was confirmed. 👉 The meeting was held in a constructive manner in a warm and friendly atmosphere. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
